title: EXP-069-R2 - Hello World Part 4 Section 9: FX_UM Property Class Extension with the Details/Add/Find Right-Click Menu on FX_UMCombobox (replay after the creation timeout)
objective: Replay of EXP-069, whose single Yes on "Property Class Extension FX_UM does not exist. Create it?" was answered by "Timeout expired waiting for response." (creation result unknown; no retry). The single ellipsis click is the existence check before any creation. Follow hello-world-pt4.md Section 9 (11:04-13:12), adapted to FX_ names, on the User-scoped FX_Items Designer Form. Select FX_UMCombobox, open Inheritance > Edit Property Class Extensions through its ellipsis, accept the prompt to create the extension once, and in it set Behavior > Add Details and Find Form: Add Details Form FX_UMs, Find Form FX_UMs, Property FX_UM, and Right-Click Menu the standard Details/Add/Find menu (record its exact name). Confirm and perform one Designer Save. Then test at runtime: reopen the runtime FX_Items Form once and right-click the Unit of Measure combobox once, recording the menu (the tutorial expects it NOT to appear, because a component-level menu overrides it). If the extension menu does not appear and FX_UMCombobox has a component-level Behavior > Right-Click Menu value (for example StdDefault), record it, clear only that value, perform a second Designer Save, reopen the runtime Form once and right-click again. If the menu then appears, choose Details once and verify that the FX_UMs Form opens on the current record's UM, then close it. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt4.md Section 9 (11:04-13:12) including the inheritance lesson, the EXP-069 record and evidence (baseline, prompt and timeout), and the EXP-045, EXP-048 and EXP-068-R2 records before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-069-R2-hello-world-part-4-section-9-um-property-class-extension-right-click.md and evidence/EXP-069-R2/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection.

Designer baseline: if no Form is loaded, open FX_Items once through the Designer toolbar Open button and Select Form; verify FX_Items in User scope and clean. Select FX_UMCombobox and record its Data Source binding, its Inheritance properties (property class and any existing extension) and every Behavior property value, in particular Right-Click Menu and the Add Details and Find Form group.

Runtime baseline: with the runtime FX_Items Form open (open it once through Form > Open > Select Form if needed), right-click the Unit of Measure combobox once, record the menu items verbatim with a screenshot, and dismiss the menu with Escape without choosing an item.

Extension: in the Designer, click the FX_UMCombobox Inheritance > Edit Property Class Extensions ellipsis once; this click is the existence check. If the prompt "Property Class Extension FX_UM does not exist. Create it?" appears, the EXP-069 creation did not complete: record it, answer Yes once and wait for the result. If the Property Class Extension dialog opens without that prompt, the extension already exists (created by EXP-069): record that and continue in the dialog. If "Timeout expired waiting for response." appears again, acknowledge it with OK once and stop blocked without clicking the ellipsis again. In the extension dialog, set Behavior > Add Details and Find Form: Add Details Form FX_UMs, Find Form FX_UMs, Property FX_UM, and Right-Click Menu the standard Details/Add/Find menu offered by its dropdown (record the exact option name and the full option list). Record every field, confirm the extension dialog once, and record its scope if shown.
Perform Designer Save 1 through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim.
Runtime check 1: close the clean runtime FX_Items Form once and reopen it once; right-click the Unit of Measure combobox once; record the menu items verbatim with a screenshot; dismiss with Escape.

Override step, only if check 1 does not show the Details/Add/Find menu and FX_UMCombobox has a non-blank component-level Right-Click Menu: record the value, clear only that property on FX_UMCombobox, verify the readback, perform Designer Save 2 and record the response; then Runtime check 2 exactly like check 1.

Cache contingency, only if the last check still does not show the menu and no component-level value remains: invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects once (no runtime Form dirty; close the clean runtime FX_Items Form first), reopen the runtime Form once and right-click once more. Never use the Designer unload.

Drill-down: when the Details/Add/Find menu appears, with dumbbell selected (UM EA), choose Details once; verify the FX_UMs Form opens on the EA record with its description Each; close that FX_UMs Form once (clean, no edits). Never choose Add or Find.

Designer recovery: close the clean FX_Items Designer Form once and reopen it once through the toolbar Open button; verify the extension settings and the final component-level Right-Click Menu value of FX_UMCombobox.

Capture screenshots of the baseline Behavior properties, the baseline runtime menu, the extension prompt, the configured extension, each Save, each runtime menu, the FX_UMs drill-down and the Designer reopen.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
out_of_scope: Changing any component other than FX_UMCombobox, or any FX_UMCombobox property other than its component-level Right-Click Menu (in the override step).
Changing the FX_UM or FX_UMBase property classes themselves, other property class extensions, IDOs, strings, themes or User Preferences.
Any unload other than the single Web Client contingency unload; any Designer unload, FormSync, deployment or regeneration.
Choosing Add or Find in the right-click menu, editing records, runtime Save, imports or exports.
Check In, Undo Check Out or other checkout-management actions.
Browser JavaScript, console or network inspection, direct URL navigation (except the portal step of the session-expiry procedure), refresh or restart.
Modifying earlier experiment records, AGENTS.md, tutorial sources, recipes or files outside the EXP-069 paths.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Never change a component other than FX_UMCombobox, or a property other than its component-level Right-Click Menu.
Never delete a property class extension, property class or component.
Never invoke the Designer Save more than twice, or retry an uncertain Save.
Never invoke more than one Web Client Unload All Global Form Objects, and never the Designer one.
Never choose Add or Find in a right-click menu, edit a record or use runtime Save.
Never close a dirty Form or discard changes without operator approval.
Never click the Designer top-toolbar Delete button (Delete Form Definition).
Never perform check-in, undo checkout or other checkout-management actions.
Never use direct SQL, scripts, application internals or browser JavaScript.
Never refresh, restart or replace the browser session; re-login only through the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure, at most once per task.
Never claim cross-session durability beyond the observed close/reopen recovery.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; FX_Items open in the Designer in User scope and clean; FX_UMCombobox binding, Inheritance and all Behavior values recorded (Right-Click Menu and the Add Details and Find Form group); the baseline runtime right-click menu recorded. Evidence: Properties and runtime-menu screenshots.

The existence check recorded (prompt present or absent on the single ellipsis click); the extension then created once (prompt verbatim, Yes once) or found existing; Add Details Form FX_UMs, Find Form FX_UMs, Property FX_UM, Right-Click Menu the standard Details/Add/Find option (exact name and option list recorded); confirmed once; scope recorded. A second timeout stops the run. Evidence: ellipsis-result and configured-extension screenshots.
Designer Save 1 with the native response verbatim; Runtime check 1 after one runtime close/reopen with the menu items recorded. Evidence: Save and menu screenshots.

Override step (if required): the component-level Right-Click Menu value of FX_UMCombobox recorded and cleared, Save 2 with its response, Runtime check 2 recorded; or the step recorded as not required. The contingency unload used at most once and only under its condition. Evidence: readback, Save and menu screenshots; unload count.
The Details/Add/Find menu appears at runtime, and Details on dumbbell opens the FX_UMs Form on EA (Each); that Form closed clean. Evidence: menu and drill-down screenshots.
The clean Designer Form closed once and reopened once; the extension settings and the final component-level Right-Click Menu of FX_UMCombobox verified. Evidence: reopen screenshots.

No other change: no other component, property, class, extension, record or object changed; no Designer unload; no Add or Find used; no dialog or menu left open. Evidence: the audit and final screenshots.

The final EXP-069-R2 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-7, the complete action audit with exact counts (one extension creation, at most two Designer Saves, runtime close/reopen count, right-click count, at most one Web Client unload, one Details drill-down, one Designer close/reopen, zero other changes, re-login count), the negative/positive inheritance observation, the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
